<title>Circle</title>
  <style>
    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    body {
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      background: #f4f4f6;
    }
    svg {
      width: min(400px, 80vw);
      height: min(400px, 80vw);
    }
    circle {
      fill: #4f8cff;
      transition: fill 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
      transform-origin: center;
    }

      fill: #2f6fe0;
      transform: scale(1.03);
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <svg id="ae683f770" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-label="Blue circle">
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="196"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>
